environment.effects: Weather and RAD are context only; only geometric daylight changes environmental mission assessment.
environment.forecast_applicability_rule: Full departure-through-reserved-return containment in the target sol; distinct leads and targets remain separate.

provider_metadata.default_explanation: First chronological eligible target coverage with geometric daylight at the prepared base, rounded upward to a UTC second; no outcome scoring.
limitations: Historical hindcast, not operational or current Mars weather.
Source rover locations/elevations are forward-filled waypoints, not a validated weather field at the hypothetical base.
Daily reports are not hourly weather; RAD is silicon detector B RTG-corrected microgray/day, not human effective dose.
SILSO uses modern revised daily values; original 2025 revisions are not recoverable.
provider_metadata.policy_description: Retrospective assumption: release after all included sol and Earth-day input intervals and frozen training inputs complete. Zero processing/publication lag is assumed, not an archival NASA timestamp. Modern source revisions remain a limitation.

environment.selection_rule: Latest eligible issue time, then effective availability, then revision within each source/kind/series; no outcome scoring.

snapshot.availability_policy: reconstruct_declared; exact eligible records only; empty selection attested at cutoff.
